label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
Hey Hollins Family Ties,

For everybody who’s been asking my mom: yes, I’m coming to Thanksgiving! I’ll see y’all Thursday, November 26, at Aunt Denise’s in Macon. We’re eating around 3, and I’m bringing the mac and cheese and two sweet potato pies.

I also want to say something about last year. Some of y’all weren’t there, but things got heated at the table, and I played my part in that. I made a crack about somebody getting their news from a gas station TV, and I shouldn’t have talked like that. Grandma ended up sitting out on the porch for about an hour, and I still feel bad that our argument spoiled part of her holiday.

I’m not sorry for the work I do. I am sorry for how I talked at Grandma’s holiday, and I’m going to do better this year. Nobody involved is a bad person, even if some people in this family do enjoy poking a little. And I got a happy birthday text with a thumbs-up in August, which in this family is basically a hug. I’m taking it as one.

So can we call a truce on work and politics for one day? And just so everybody knows, I can’t talk about open cases anyway because of confidentiality, so questions about “the lawsuit” are a dead end.

I’m looking forward to seeing everybody, and I really want it to be a good day. Let’s keep the table talk to food, football, babies, and Tasha’s new boyfriend. Tasha, you’ve been warned. ❤️
